description: Typewell GR cross-correlation features: sliding-window cross-correlation between lateral GR and typewell GR. For each row, compute best_lag, best_corr, corr_top3_mean, corr_argmax_position, and the lag where DTW/correlation distance to typewell is minimized. This is the core TVT domain signal and is expected to massively beat the baseline.
implementation_notes: For each well, take a rolling GR window (e.g., 51 samples centered on each row) and cross-correlate against the corresponding typewell's GR series over lag range [-60, +60] in TVT units.
The typewell GR is indexed by TVT. Use TVT_input_filled as the prior center for the search window when available; otherwise search globally within the well's typewell TVT range.
Report at every row: best_lag (argmax of correlation), best_corr (max value), peakiness = (max - median) / (std + 1e-6).
Smooth best_lag along MD with a rolling mean (window 50) since TVT changes smoothly — that smoothed lag IS effectively a TVT estimate.
Use GroupKFold by well_id, 5 folds. Compare CV RMSE to exp_b001 (37.11). Save OOF and test predictions in the exact row order of the train and test CSVs.
Add the feature-extraction code to src/features.py as a new function `add_typewell_correlation_features(df, typewell_df)`.
